messages.subject: Statconn R WebService
parts:
I am trying to setup a webservice and i found Statconn does provide
one which is Beta release.

You can download from http://rcom.univie.ac.at/download.html

I was able to start the WS sample provided and tried connecting
through Ruby client.

I get an error

Starting statconnWS in D:\Programs\WS\bin\..
Started Simple Axis2 HTTP Server ...
axis2_get_instance(00A9FD18,008BA7C0)
AXIS2_FAILURE axis2_get_instance(00000000,008BA7C0)
Press any key to continue . . .

here is the ruby client source that i am trying.

~~~~~~~~~~

require 'soap/rpc/driver'

NAMESPACE = 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/">'
URL = 'http://localhost:9090/services/StatConnector'

begin
driver = SOAP::RPC::Driver.new(URL, NAMESPACE)

# Add remote sevice methods
driver.add_method('EvaluateNoReturn')

# Call remote service methods
puts driver.EvaluateNoReturn()
rescue => err
puts err.message
end

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

There is a testclient exe provideed with the sample bundle but i there
is no source code, though it lanuches with some window but not sure
what it is.

Regards
Venkat
